about_the_game:
Flip or Fade: The Bottle Flip

Succeed or perish. Our fate-gambling flip is about to begin.

Welcome to "Flip or Fade: The Bottle Flip," an online 4-player competitive bottle flip game set in a bizarre limbo between this world and the next.

You awaken to a single mission: to endlessly flip bottles, stream your performance to the world, and earn a living. But this is no mere game. Succeed, or face eternal oblivion. Your destiny is decided on the table!

Gameplay

  • The Harsh Streamer Life Your streaming hours are from 5 AM to 11 PM every day. Land a magnificent flip, and your viewer count will soar. The fervor of your audience will become your daily income.

  • The Tri-Daily Contract Fee To continue streaming, you must pay a hefty streaming contract fee every three days. Fail to make the payment, and your existence will meet its end.

  • A Challenge for Freedom Survive for 10 days and earn enough to completely captivate the world, and freedom may await you.

Key Features

  • Fight Alongside and Compete with Comrades Up to 4 players can join the online competitive multiplayer. Will you cooperate with your comrades to make your stream a sensation, or will you compete to steal the viewers' hearts as rivals? The dynamic among your comrades is a crucial element of this game!

  • A Diverse Cast of Bottles Purchase a variety of bottles from the online shop, "Haven Market." Each bottle has unique characteristics. Master their different traits to achieve the perfect flip.

  • Story and Mystery As you endlessly flip alone, you receive cryptic messages from your viewers every morning. What is the truth behind this peculiar island, and what is your fate? As you continue your stream, the world's distortions and their reasons will gradually become clear.

  • Simple Controls and Deep Strategy The simple controls of the mouse make bottle flipping easy for anyone. However, your skills and choice of bottles will be put to the test if you want to increase your success rate and earn efficiently.

What awaits you at the end of this high-stakes bottle flip? Freedom, or despair? Take your seat and face the flip!
